releaseNotes: Offline readiness and update checks now run silently in the background while the seven-second splash screen is visible.
The offline setup overlay is not created at all when every current asset is already cached and passes byte-length and SHA-256 verification, preventing a post-splash flash.
First-time setup and genuine missing/changed-file recovery screens still appear after the splash screen.
Previously verified cached files are reused; the full offline package is not downloaded again when the current assets are already present and valid.
